biggest_catch: Daily-challenge bonuses are small — meaningful earnings require grinding surveys and offer walls, and offer-wall tracking sometimes fails to credit.
catches: Points equal 1 cent each (100 points = $1); daily/weekly challenge bonuses add only modest amounts.
Survey disqualifications are frequent and unpaid.
Offer-wall credits can fail to track — take screenshots as proof of completion.
PrizeRebel runs regular anti-fraud checks and removes manipulated accounts — one account per person, no VPNs.

steps: Create a free account at prizerebel.com and confirm your email.
Complete your profile (awards 10 points) to unlock surveys.
Log in daily and work toward the Daily Challenge activity goal for bonus points.
Complete surveys and offer-wall tasks to build your balance.
Redeem on the Rewards page for gift cards, PayPal, Venmo, bank transfer, or crypto once you have enough points.
timing: Bonus points credit when you hit the day's challenge goal; redemptions via gift cards, PayPal, Venmo, bank transfer, or crypto.
